Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game! It is Bangladesh who have taken a 1-0 lead in this series. Still two more games to go and the second ODI will be played on the 15th of March. Do join us for the coverage. Until next time, goodbye and take care.

Najmul Hossain Shanto, the captain if Bangladesh wins the Player of the Match award for his incredible knock. He starts by saying that they knew they would find it difficult with the new ball. Informs he took his time and backed his skill, once the dew came in play the ball started to sit up nicely. Praises the way Shoriful Islam and Taskin Ahmed came back at the later stage. Adds that the experience of Mahmudullah and Rahim help them a lot as a unit. Hopes that the latter continues in the similar fashion.

Kusal Mendis, tha captain of Sri Lanka starts by praising the opening pair, Nissanka and Fernando who set the tone for their innings. Adds that the middle order struggled and hence they couldn't put up a good score. Informs that they bowled well initially but the dew came in and it became difficult to control the ball later on.

Pramod Madushan and Dilshan Madushanka were absolutely brilliant with the new ball but that was about it. They managed to get early wickets but as the game progressed, as the dew came in, everything kept getting tough for the bowlers. The spinners weren't that effective and that proved to be the downfall for the visitors. However, we believe they were at least 20 runs short of what would have been a competitive total. They were just below par in this game.

What an outstanding chase and what an outstanding innings from Shanto! Take a bow, his side needed a hero and he has led from the front. Chasing a moderate score, Bangladesh were in all sorts at 3 down for not a lot. Shanto and Mahmudullah then steadied the ship. Mahmudullah fell with Bangladesh still needing over 150 but then came the match winning stand. A 150-plus run partnership between Rahim and Shanto. Shanto scored a brilliant ton and Rahim a very good fifty. A partnership and an innings to remember. Top stuff.

FOUR! Up and over and it is the skipper who hits the winning runs and helps his side over the line. This is fuller and on off. It is lifted over mid off and it goes to the fence. BANGLADESH WIN BY 6 WICKETS!

Commentary.Commentary: Goes for the wide yorker and nails it. Najmul Hossain Shanto dabs it out to point once again. Pramod Madushan finally has found his rhythm here.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Pramod Madushan to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wobble seam this time, full in length, on off. This one nips back in sharply. Najmul Hossain Shanto gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Pramod Madushan to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Captain under pressure. Najmul Hossain Shanto is struggling to find his timing. He is yet to get off the mark. Pramod Madushan fires it full, wide outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto reaches out and taps it to point for none.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Pramod Madushan to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, around the hips. Towhid Hridoy clips it to deep square leg for one more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Pramod Madushan to Towhid Hridoy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full this time, on the pads. Towhid Hridoy flicks it aerially but gets it through the gap and crosses for one. He opens his account.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Dilshan Madushanka to Towhid Hridoy, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Length, on the pads. Towhid Hridoy stays back and tucks it into mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Dilshan Madushanka to Towhid Hridoy, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Towhid Hridoy comes out at number 4.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust for Bangladesh inside the first Powerplay. Dilshan Madushanka is on fire. He picks up his second in no time. It is a sharp bumper, outside off. This one flies off the deck as well. Soumya Sarkar gets on his front foot and tries to pull it away. The ball though catches the outside edge and lobs towards mid-wicket. Maheesh Theekshana there takes a sitter. Sri Lanka are putting in a solid fight here.
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Dilshan Madushanka
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Dilshan Madushanka to Soumya Sarkar, OUT! c Maheesh Theekshana b Dilshan Madushanka.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off. Soumya Sarkar cuts it to point off the bottom half. No real timing on this one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Dilshan Madushanka to Soumya Sarkar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller once again, on off. Soumya Sarkar blocks it to backward point off the outer half.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Dilshan Madushanka to Soumya Sarkar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, on off. Soumya Sarkar defends it from inside the crease.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Dilshan Madushanka to Soumya Sarkar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pramod Madushan nails the yorker this time, in the blockhole. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to dig it out but misses. He takes a blow on his pads. Pramod Madushan appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Sri Lanka go for the review here. UltraEdge confirms no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking confirms that the ball is missing the wickets. A never-ending over from Pramod Madushan finally comes to an end here.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Pramod Madushan to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: It is full, on leg. Soumya Sarkar looks to flick it away and does so towards square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Down the leg side once again. Pramod Madushan needs to get his line right. Third wide of the over, fortunately Mendis is able to make the stop this time.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length this time, around off, shaping a bit away. Soumya Sarkar hangs his blade away from the body and gets beaten.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs! Bangladesh will accept it gleefully. It is a short ball, that lands around leg, but moves down the leg side. Soumya Sarkar stays back and tries to get some bat on it but fails again. Kusal Mendis puts in a full-stretched dive to his right but once again in vain.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, 5 Wides!

Commentary.Commentary: FIVE WIDES! Pramod Madushan fires in a full toss, around leg. This one swings down the leg side. Soumya Sarkar looks to flick it away but misses. The ball flies past the keeper as well and goes on to kiss the fence at fine leg.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, 5 Wides!

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, outside off. Soumya Sarkar waits for it and guides it towards deep point. The fielder in the deep rushes to his left and keeps it down to a couple.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Pramod Madushan now dishes it on a hard length, outside off. Soumya Sarkar defends it by hanging his bat away from his body. Bangladesh yet to open their account.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full this time, outside off. Soumya Sarkar leaves it alone.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Pramod Madushan to Soumya Sarkar, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pramod Madushan to bowl with the second new ball.
Woah! Incredible stuff! A wicket-maiden to start the run chase. The hosts certainly on the backfoot here. Fuller one, on off. Shanto prods and defends it wisely.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Dilshan Madushanka to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: An away swinging delivery this time, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto toe-ends it back to the bowler. Bangladesh yet to open their account.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Dilshan Madushanka to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Dilshan Madushanka serves a short ball, outside off, swinging away. Najmul Hossain Shanto ends up hanging his blade away from the body.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Dilshan Madushanka to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Much fuller, on the fifth stump line. Najmul Hossain Shanto leans into it and defends it out solidly.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Dilshan Madushanka to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Dilshan Madushanka fires in a yorker length delivery, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto defends it wisely from inside the crease.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Dilshan Madushanka to Najmul Hossain Shanto, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! CHOPPED ON! Dilshan Madushanka draws the first blood on the very first delivery of the run chase. Litton Das trudges back on a golden duck. Dilshan Madushanka dishes a good-length ball, outside off, and gets it to nip back into the right-hander. Litton Das tries to cut it away from inside the crease but fails to get a clean connection on it. The ball catches the inside edge and heads straight into the leg pole. Najmul Hossain Shanto is out in the middle now.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Dilshan Madushanka to Litton Das, OUT! b Dilshan Madushanka.
